LanguageData.RavenRace_AutoInsertDesc: When enabled, if out of combat and the spirit bead is not inside, it will automatically attempt to insert it.\n(Does not trigger while drafted)
LanguageData.RavenRace_InsertBeadsDesc: Manually insert the spirit egg bead to prepare a powerful attack.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Msg_BeadsPopOut: {0} unequipped their weapon, and the spirit bead slipped out.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Settings_EnableGrandClimaxDesc: Allows the spirit egg bead to use a map-wide powerful crowd-control ability. Disabled by default for balance.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Msg_GrandClimaxDisabled: This ability is disabled in mod settings.
LanguageData.RavenRace_Msg_GrandClimaxUnleashed: {0} unleashed the full potential of the spirit bead, and the battlefield was flooded with lewd aura!
